ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2.5:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity (black) anchor region bifurcating at the notch. Broad lateral high-intensity (white) fields characterized by high-frequency, stochastic low-intensity mottling. Continuous low-intensity boundary mapping the entire trailing edge contour.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 50 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration; trailing edge shows high-amplitude jagged peaks on the lateral third of both lobes, transitioning to lower-amplitude oscillations near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curvature along the lobe margins, terminating in sharp, slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-intensity, roughly circular raised pixel groups on the distal left tip (epibiont colonization). Sparse dark circular focal spots distributed across the white ventral fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent dark linear mark on the right lobe distal quadrant; multiple fine, vertical linear disruptions visible within the medial white sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible epibiotic clusters (barnacles) on the far-left lobe tip; distinct irregular notches/chips along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellow-brown chromatic shifts (diatom film) observed as low-saturation patches on the white ventral surfaces of both lobes.
